title: 20th Sitting of second session of 2026
summary: The 20th sitting of the second session of 2026 opened with 26 members in the chamber, then published three written answers to questions from Maaroof Zakir about waste, electricity and engine-house projects on Kihaadhoo and Kamadhoo. Most of the sitting continued the debate on the bill on uninhabited islands and leasing of barren land, where PNC members backed the bill as a transparent leasing system and MDP members raised constitutional and presidential-power concerns, with sharp exchanges and several points of order not accepted by the chair. After a half-hour break the chamber voted 57-0 to approve Ambassador Tariq Ibrahim as the Maldives' permanent representative to IRENA. The island bill's debate was not concluded. The text is partly garbled in places, so some gists are approximate.

items.title: Opening of the sitting and prayer
Attendance of members
items.outcome: 26 present, 4 on leave, 6 on official travel announced

items.title: Announcements by the chair: changes to committee membership
items.outcome: Komandoo MP Mohamed Ibrahim placed on State and Enterprises Committee in place of Dhiggaru MP Ahmed Nazim, and Nazim on Petitions Committee in place of Ibrahim

items.title: Written question by Maaroof Zakir (Kendhoo) to the Climate Change, Environment and Energy minister on the Kihaadhoo waste management centre extension
items.outcome: minister's written answer published as is: work handed to FENAKA in March 2025 but not started, council wants design changes, completion targeted for July 2027

items.title: Written question by Maaroof Zakir (Kendhoo) on electricity load and supply problems in Kamadhoo
items.outcome: written answer published: handover to STELCO done July 2026, cable fault fixed, network upgrade survey and design done, completion estimated by November 2027

items.title: Written question by Maaroof Zakir (Kendhoo) on the new Kihaadhoo engine house building and relocation
items.outcome: written answer published: prototype design and land set, relocation targeted for 31 October 2027

items.title: First reading of a bill to amend the Decentralisation Act (Law 7/2010), submitted by Abdul Hannan Aboobakuru (Thulhaadhoo)
Continued debate on the bill on uninhabited islands and leasing of barren land (submitted by Saudulla Hilmy, North Thinadhoo, for the government)
items.outcome: debated; not concluded, interrupted at 10:30 for a break

items.title: Foreign Relations Committee report on the President's nomination of Ambassador Tariq Ibrahim as the Maldives' permanent representative to the International Renewable Energy Agency
Items for vote
items.outcome: vote on the permanent representative nomination, passed 57-0

speakers.name: Ibrahim Falah
positions: Supported the bill, saying it fixes lease rates openly, and disputed the MDP's record on island leasing.
Raised two points of order, which the chair did not accept as procedural points, on claims made about the bill.

speakers.name: Hussain Ziyad
positions: Said the bill gives the president full power to lease islands and removes council powers, and argued existing protections should remain.
Argued over the constitution's article 73 and objected to what he saw as a closed political climate.

speakers.name: Maaroof Zakir
positions: Asked when the Kihaadhoo waste management centre extension will be finished.
Asked when Kamadhoo's electricity load and new-area supply problems will be fixed.
Asked why work on the new Kihaadhoo engine house has not started and when it will finish.

speakers.name: Dr. Ahmed Shamheed
positions: Said the president should not hold unlimited power to lease islands, argued some clauses conflict with the constitution on taking property, and asked for limits and a protected share of land.
Raised a point of order citing the constitution's article on property, which the chair did not accept.
Asked the chair to explain how item 7.2 on the agenda was handled.

speakers.name: Hussain Sameer
positions: Opposed the bill, citing earlier laws on islands, tourism and land, and objected to giving the president full leasing powers.
Said the country needs stronger enforcement, not a law that makes selling islands easier.

speakers.name: Dr. Anara Naeem
positions: Welcomed the barren-islands bill and urged the committee stage to set sound rules, protect the environment and share benefits with citizens.

speakers.name: Ibrahim Hussain
positions: Said leasing must not let a few people benefit, citing past leases of islands near Male, and wanted Fuvahmulah City to get an island whose benefit goes to its council.

speakers.name: Ibrahim Shujau
positions: Supported the bill, saying it sets open rules for leasing and ends past giving of islands to favoured people, and backed combining farming, fishing and tourism uses.

speakers.name: Ibrahim Didi
positions: Supported the bill and said islands should be designated for tourism, farming or fishing after environmental study and in line with decentralisation.

speakers.name: Ibrahim Muhammad
positions: Supported the bill, saying the 28-year-old law needs updating for new industries and referring to audit findings on past island leases.

speakers.name: Mohamed Mamdooh
positions: Raised a point of order saying the website onemap.mv works, contradicting a claim by a previous speaker.

speakers.name: Mohamed Ismail
positions: Supported the amendment, said past MDP-era governments leased many islands to close associates, and defended the current government's reforms.

speakers.name: Hussain Shareef
positions: Said the 28-year-old law needs reform, warned against over-reliance on tourism and urged using islands to build local production and farming.

speakers.name: Mohamed Dawoodh
positions: As deputy rapporteur, presented the Foreign Relations Committee's report approving the IRENA permanent representative nomination.

decisions: The chamber approved Ambassador Tariq Ibrahim as the Maldives' permanent representative to the International Renewable Energy Agency, 57 votes in favour and none against.
Mohamed Ibrahim (Komandoo) was placed on the State and Enterprises Committee, replacing Ahmed Nazim (Dhiggaru), who was placed on the Petitions Committee instead.
Written answers to three questions from Maaroof Zakir were published without change.
The first reading of a bill amending the Decentralisation Act was held.
The next sitting was announced for Monday 10 August 2026 at 09:00.

votes.what: Approval of Ambassador Tariq Ibrahim as permanent representative to the International Renewable Energy Agency (93 members, 58 present, 29 needed)
